notes.title: Effects and background updates
notes.content: Added a few new effects, redid some old ones and added more graffiti to some of the backgrounds.

notes.title: Occultus Command on Sale and some updates
notes.content:
Occultus Command is on sale for the next couple of days and I also added some small changes and updates in the meantime.
Changes:

 Added a new weapon for Lia that is unlocked from the start, all you have to do is make it to the first weapon checkpoint.
 Added some more navigation tips for Level 1 (in the background).
 Fixed some issues with the formatting for the game over tips
 Fixed some issues with the alternate weapon moves not coming out as easily


I actually have to apply these changes to the demo as well, but I'll try and get that done this weekend. I figured it's more important for the main game. So...I've seen more people play the game...I don't know why many players skip the tutorial...and then complain about the game being too hard, I mean...I guess the game is hard, but some of the complaints: stun locked, not being able to change fast enough, are actually addressed in tips, or the training mode. Either way, good luck and a big thanks to everybody who's tried their luck. 

Also, in case it's helpful, here's a how to video:
[previewyoutube=UcDX5BfCias;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Maps, ending, achievements and new level
New Update and How to Video!
notes.content:
Hope this message finds everyone doing alright during these trying times. I was anticipating getting this done a lot earlier but had some personal matters crop up, either way, managed to get a nice update uploaded and completed for the game and it's live now! 

Update:

 Added a new enemy type in Level 1
 Added a new boss for the Grind Hall level
 Added a new Weapon for Lia
 New moves for both Lia and Felius: the air geyser stomp
 New backgrounds and art!


Game's not dead, I'm still working on some more updates to include more enemies and bosses and the final level along with a new ending. I might also tweak some of the weapons and add more animation and backgrounds. 
There was a local gaming convention that was indie friendly that I wanted to attend, but seems like that won't happen, but if you've been enjoying the game, feel free to tweet, stream or review it! Also, here's a video on how to play it. Feel free to drop me a line, message, reply to a post or whatever and I'll respond! 

Thanks.  
P.S: If anybody knows of any youtubers, streamers or reviewers, please spread the word!
[previewyoutube=UcDX5BfCias;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Oh yeah, started brushing up on my digital art skills and updated the company logo! It's a "macarao".

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
Game's still got life commandos!! 
So sometime in the next couple of weeks, hopefully by the end of the month there's going to be an update to Occultus Command:
This will add two new moves per character, a new enemy type and a new boss, with a few new small areas.
I'm having to pack up and move to a new place, and moving sucks, plus my new internet provider is the one with the data cap, but on the bright side I'll have more space to breath and work on the game once the move is complete.
I also got a new computer, so now I'm able to upload more video content to show off the new updates! Once I unpack everything I'll get to work on all this. 
I have a list of some other things that I would like to add for the update after this one:

 more weapons;
 more achievements;
 a new level; and
 a new boss. 


I'll also look into the whole remote coop play, I'll test it out and see how it works, and I might also add some more keyboard and controller configurations as well as beefing up the tutorial and hints. 
I'll try and add at least two more updates after this one, then play it by ear and see how it's received.
